title: Education, Communications & Outreach Officer
description:
Education, Communications and Outreach Officer
Salary: 28,000 - 36,000 dependent on experience plus Veolia benefits
Location: Lumley Street, S4 7 ZJ, Sheffield with travel to other sites
Hours: Full-time, permanent, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday 08.30-17.00, some work may also be required outside office hours / at weekends
Duration: 3 years FTC
To apply please provide a 1-page cover letter and a CV (max 2 pages).
If you are passionate about delivering impactful campaigns to promote recycling and improve environmental behaviours and enjoy working on projects and engaging with communities to inspire change, then we want you to join our team as an Education Communications and Outreach Officer in Sheffield.
What we can offer you;
- 25 days of annual leave
- Access to our company pension scheme
- Discounts on everything from groceries to well known retailers
- Access to a range of resources to support your physical, mental and financial health; so you can lean on us whenever you need to
- One paid days leave every year to volunteer and support your community
- Ongoing training and development opportunities, allowing you to reach your full potential
- Stream - Employee financial well-being support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & rewards.

What you'll be doing
Researching, developing, and delivering projects to promote recycling and increase waste minimisation behaviour change across Sheffield and its local communities

Coordinate and deliver engagement and education with Sheffield residents and stakeholders through visits, correspondence, events, meetings, schools and community sessions

Creating briefs and managing relationships with design agencies, printers, and other third-party suppliers to provide effective communications materials

Support the Local ECO Manager to deliver regional and national communications objectives within contract, as required

Supporting the External Engagement team with the preparation of press releases, website updates, and social media communications

Supporting internal communications campaigns to improve our working culture and safety performance
Where you will work

You will be based at our site in Sheffield, which includes our award-winning ERF and District Energy Network that treats waste from over 250,000 households in Sheffield to create heat and electricity for the city.
This role also includes travel across Sheffield to deliver educational and outreach sessions/talks to groups, residents and schools to promote correct recycling and waste minimisation behaviours.
What we're looking for
Essential
- Proven experience in behaviour change, community engagement and outreach work
- Proven experience in project planning and management
- Proven experience in crisis communications and copywriting
- Strong communication and presentation skills, with a high degree of attention to detail
- Proven experience in digital communications and social media implementation
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills
- Excellent written and spoken English
- Ability to demonstrate creativity and innovation, especially within communications
- Strong Microsoft Office/Google Suite software skills and highly computer-literate
- Strong negotiation skills with the ability to remain calm under pressure

Desirable
- Strong interest in sustainability and environmental awareness
- Experience working in the waste management or environmental sector
- Experience in website management

If you don't meet all of our outlined requirements we'd still love for you to apply. If you feel that you'd be a great fit for this role and Veolia then we'd like to find out more about you.

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

We're dedicated to supporting you throughout your application journey, offering adjustments where reasonable and appropriate. As a proud Disability Confident Employer, we will offer an interview to applicants with a disability or long-term condition who opt-in to the Disability Confident scheme, and meet the minimum criteria for our roles.

We're also committed to ensuring that all applicants and colleagues receive fair treatment without discrimination on any grounds, aiming to create a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: Marketing Co-ordinator
company: Sue Ross Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Sue Ross Recruitment are delighted to be working with a highly successful and expanding Sheffield-based business, operating within the construction and industrial products sector, to recruit an experienced Marketing Co-ordinator.

This is an exciting opportunity for a creative, hands-on marketing professional who can confidently take ownership of content creation and digital marketing activity from day one. Working within a small marketing team and reporting directly to the Marketing Director, you will play a key role in increasing brand awareness and engagement across multiple channels.

Key Responsibilities:
- Creating engaging content for social media platforms including LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube
- Filming, editing and publishing video content
- Developing and implementing social media campaigns to drive engagement and brand visibility
- Producing marketing materials including brochures, product literature and promotional assets
- Working with sales teams to fulfil marketing collateral requests
- Monitoring campaign performance and making recommendations for improvement
- Assisting with influencer and partnership marketing activities
- Ensuring brand consistency across all marketing communications

The Successful Candidate Will Have:
- Proven experience within a marketing role, ideally with responsibility for content creation and social media management
- Strong working knowledge of the Adobe Creative Suite
- Experience of filming and editing video content for digital platforms
- Excellent copywriting and communication skills
- The ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, hands-on approach with the confidence to hit the ground running
- Experience within a product-led, manufacturing, industrial or construction-related environment would be advantageous but is not essential

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to 35,000
- Full-time permanent position
- Office-based role in Sheffield
- Working hours of 8:30am to 5:00pm Monday to Thursday and 8:30am to 4:00pm Friday

Unfortunately due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. Please assume that if you do not hear from us within 72 hours that your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

May we take this opportunity to thank you for expressing an interest in one of our roles and wish you the very best in your search for employment.

title: Digital Marketing Executive (Content Creation)
description:
Our client is a growing recruitment organisation dedicated to connecting talented individuals with outstanding career opportunities across multiple sectors. They are seeking a creative and ambitious Digital Marketing Executive to support their marketing activities and strengthen their online presence.

Role overview

The successful candidate will be responsible for creating engaging digital content that attracts candidates and clients across various online platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a career in digital marketing and content creation within a fast-paced recruitment environment.

Key duties
- Create engaging content for social media channels including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok.
- Develop written content such as blogs, articles, candidate success stories and company updates.
- Assist with email marketing campaigns.
- Create graphics, videos and promotional materials using design software.
- Monitor social media engagement and respond to enquiries where appropriate.
- Support website updates and content management activities.
- Analyse campaign performance and produce basic reports.
- Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.

Candidate requirements
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Creative mindset with an eye for detail.
- Interest in social media, content creation and digital marketing.
- Good organisational and time-management skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Basic knowledge of Canva is advantageous.

title: Marketing Executive
description:
Role: Marketing Executive - Sheffield

Hours: Monday- Friday

Salary: £28k- £32k DOE

Benefits:
- Healthcare cashplan scheme
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Bonus schemes
- Life assurance
- Wellbeing activities
- Enhanced maternity / paternity / adoption packages
- Enhanced pension contributions
- Free parking

Our client is a global leader in their field. With decades of technical expertise, we support customers across a wide range of industries with innovative technologies that enable efficient, compliant, and sustainable operations.

Operating throughout the UK, Europe, and North America, our client combines technical excellence with award-winning solutions to address complex environmental and industrial challenges.

We are seeking a proactive and creative Marketing Executive to join our growing team in Sheffield. This is a varied, hands-on role that will support the planning and delivery of integrated marketing campaigns across digital and traditional channels. You'll be involved in content creation, website management, event coordination, lead generation activities, market research and campaign reporting.

Working closely with sales, technical and product teams, you'll help ensure our marketing activities effectively communicate expertise and value to customers across multiple industries and international markets.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in the Sheffield area that will require occasional UK and European travel, including overnight stays.

Responsibilities:
- Plan and support the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns.
- Create engaging content for websites, email marketing, social media, brochures and other marketing materials.
- Conduct market and competitor research to identify trends, opportunities and customer insights.
- Manage and update website content, ensuring information remains accurate and relevant.
- Support lead generation activities and campaign performance reporting.
- Coordinate exhibitions, conferences, webinars and customer events.
- Work with internal stakeholders to develop compelling technical and commercial messaging.
- Monitor and report on marketing performance using analytics and CRM platforms.

Abilities, Experience & Skills:
- A Marketing qualification or at least 12 months' experience in a marketing role.
- Experience within industrial, environmental, engineering, manufacturing or technology sectors would be advantageous.
- Understanding of market research and the ability to analyse customer needs, industry trends and competitor activity.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Experience using CRM systems, email marketing platforms, social media management tools, and analytics software.
- Familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite, Canva or similar design platforms.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Support Dog is an energetic, innovative national health and disability charity. We have been saving and improving the lives of children and adults affected by autism, epilepsy and disability for over 30 years. We train and provide specialist assistance dogs to achieve this

Founded and entirely based in Sheffield our charity has grown significantly over recent years. Faced with a huge demand for our services, we have recently moved to a new centre to enable us to be able to grow and help many more people. Support Dogs provides all services free of charge and relies entirely on voluntary donations for funding.

We are seeking an experienced, driven and creative Marketing Manager. As a key member of our team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing multi-channel marketing strategies that support fundraising, engage existing and new stakeholders as well as bringing our brand to life.

This is an exciting opportunity to work as a 360-marketer, at ambitious and growing charity, utilising your expertise in various channels and collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation and external agency partners.

You will lead on planning, delivering, and evaluating marketing campaigns to maximise the charity's impact and line managing our marketing team.

In return for your efforts, you will receive a competitive salary and staff benefits such as stakeholder pension scheme entitlement and private health care.

title: Paid Social & Digital Campaigns Specialist
description:
Role: Paid Social & Digital Campaigns Specialist - Sheffield

Type: Part time 24 hours per week (additional hours can be agreed)

Type: 6 month Fixed term contract

Salary: £40k full time equivalent

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on paid digital specialist to turn campaign briefs into live awareness and traffic campaigns across the UK, France, Germany and Italy. Reporting to the Head of DTC Marketing, you will personally build audiences and campaigns in the advertising platforms, upload assets, launch activity, monitor performance and make improvements.

Meta is the core requirement, with YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok and other channels used where the campaign warrants them. Activity will span always-on campaigns, product launches and seasonal campaigns.

Group Marketing provides campaign direction, core messaging, and key assets, including video and influencer content. As part of the DTC team you will work with them and our web sales team to translate those inputs into practical digital activation plans and deliver the campaigns yourself.

Responsibilities:
- Turn campaign briefs into channel plans covering objectives, audience targeting, formats, timings, proposed budgets, and testing priorities.
- Identify and brief the assets required by platform and market. Adapt core messaging into ad copy and coordinate translations and local approval.
- Personally build and manage campaigns, ad sets or equivalent structures, audiences, budgets, placements and ads in each agreed platform and market account.
- Upload creative, check copy, links, tracking and settings, obtain approval and set campaigns live. Monitor spend and results, test variations, and optimise activity.
- Coordinate with country web managers and their PPC agencies so awareness and traffic activity connects with local retargeting and conversion campaigns. YouTube will be the main area of direct Google campaign execution, with ownership agreed alongside the local agencies.
- Check landing-page readiness, stock and offer information with local teams. Apply consistent campaign naming and UTM tagging, check measurement readiness and escalate technical issues.
- Maintain always-on activity while managing overlapping launches, typically one campaign being finalised and another entering planning or build phase across the four markets.
- Report performance by market, channel and campaign, explain what the results mean and recommend improvements for future activity.
- Provide occasional organic social support where agreed, with paid campaign delivery as the main priority.

Abilities, Experience & Skills:

Essential:
- Proven experience personally building, launching and optimising paid Meta campaigns. You should be confident working directly in advertising accounts and able to explain your setup and optimisation decisions.
- Experience delivering paid awareness and traffic campaigns, with an understanding of how these support retargeting and conversion activity.
- Experience with YouTube advertising and the ability to work across additional paid channels as required.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the confidence to coordinate creative requirements, deadlines and approvals across several teams and markets.
- Ability to interpret advertising and website analytics, manage spend against agreed budgets and turn results into clear recommendations.
- Ability to work independently within agreed priorities and communicate promptly when assets, approvals or technical issues put delivery at risk.

Preferable:
- LinkedIn and TikTok experience.
- Canva, Photoshop or video editing skills.
- Experience of international campaigns, ecommerce, Criteo or testing emerging paid channels
- Additional language skills.

Required skills:
- Proven experience managing an Amazon marketplace for consumer goods.
- Experience with Amazon Vendor Central or/and Amazon Seller Central,
- In-depth knowledge of product listing optimization and advertising features.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make data-driven decisions.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Familiarity with e-commerce and digital marketing trends.
- Problem-solving and decision-making abilities in a fast-paced environment.

title: SEO Executive
description:
Are you an experienced SEO professional looking for a flexible part-time opportunity with a highly competitive salary of £50k FTE? We are seeking a talented SEO Executive to join our clients growing team in Sheffield, playing a key role in driving organic growth, increasing online visibility, and enhancing digital performance across multiple channels. This is an office-based position offering flexibility around working hours and the potential for additional hours as the business continues to expand.

The Role

As SEO Executive, you will take ownership of both strategic and hands-on SEO activity, ensuring websites achieve strong organic search performance and generate high-quality traffic and leads.

Key responsibilities include:
- Developing and implementing effective on-page SEO strategies
- Conducting technical SEO audits and working to resolve issues affecting website performance
- Writing engaging, SEO-optimised articles, blogs, and website copy
- Creating and managing content strategies to improve search rankings
- Building high-quality backlinks through ethical outreach and link-building campaigns
- Supporting PR and digital outreach activities to increase brand authority and online presence

About You
- Strong understanding of both on-page and technical SEO principles
- Excellent copywriting and content creation skills
- Experience managing backlink and outreach campaigns
- Excellent communication skills and attention to detail

What's On Offer?
- Competitive salary equivalent to £50,000 per annum FTE
- Flexible working hours to fit around your schedule
- Part-time role working 2-3 days per week
- Opportunity for additional hours as the business grows
- Stable, long-term opportunity with autonomy and ownership of SEO strategy
- Supportive and collaborative office environment in Sheffield

This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially minded SEO professional seeking flexibility alongside a highly competitive salary and the chance to make a genuine impact within a growing business.

To apply, please submit your CV today. Early applications are encouraged as interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
